        With this mod, you can use some of the NPC's vanilla furnitures.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/fq7WJJf/Preview.png[/img]





[img]https://i.ibb.co/cXYJNjW/Text1.png[/img]


[b][color=#ff7700]  [/color][color=#cc0000] [/color] Important:[/b] 

  Remember to "SAVE" your "SAVE FILES".


1[b].[/b] Install [b][url=https://smapi.io/][/url][/b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][url=https://smapi.io/][/url].

2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url].

3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PYTK[/url].

4. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8321?tab=files]NPC's Furniture[/url].

5. Unpack﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PYTK[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/edit/%3Cspan%3Ehttps://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726][/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/edit/%3Cspan%3E%3Cspan%3Ehttps://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8321?tab=files%3C/span%3E]NPC's Furniture[/url] to your mod's folder.

6. Run the game through [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].exe.

7. Get the furniture through Robin at her shop or at the furniture catalagoue.



[img]https://i.ibb.co/FWQF1WH/Text1.png[/img]

[b]•[/b] Please SAVE your "Save files" before downloading any mods!

[b]•[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/edit/%3Cspan%3Ehttps://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url] is currently buggy and some furnitures might change into something new.
